# SHIPPING LANES AND TRAVEL TIMES [italic]How long it takes to get from here to there, if there is a ship going there, and if it is going today.[/italic]
## TYPICAL JOURNEYS - [bold]Gateway Station to the Core worlds.[/bold] Weeks. Well travelled. Expect queues at customs and a gift shop. - [bold]Gateway Station to {colony}.[/bold] Months, in hypersleep, on a hauler, a supply run or a troopship if you have upset someone. - [bold]{colony} to the next colony over.[/bold] Weeks, if a ship is going. A ship is usually not going. - [bold]The Outer Veil to anywhere.[/bold] A long time. Bring a book. Bring several books. Bring a long book.
## TRAFFIC REPORT - [color=#FFE066]Heavy.[/color] Gateway approach. Three freighters, one Company yacht and a USCM troopship that will not say where it is going. - [color=#FFE066]Slow.[/color] Outer Veil relay line. A buoy is down, so ships are navigating by the old charts. - [color=#FF6655]Closed.[/color] The lane past the border survey zone, by joint order of the United Americas and the Union of Progressive Peoples, who agree on nothing except this. - [color=#9BE15D]Clear.[/color] Every lane in the direction of the colonies that have gone quiet. Nobody is going that way.
## ROUTE TIPS - Book your hypersleep pod early. Window pods go first, and nobody knows why. There is nothing to see. - Pack light. Your luggage travels separately. It arrives when it arrives. - If a ship answers a distress call on the way, you will be late. You may be very late. Tell your family.
